INSERT INTO miner_identity ("payoutId", kind, descriptor, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
           VALUES ($1, 'rotating', $2, $3, $3)
           ON CONFLICT ("payoutId") DO UPDATE SET
             kind = 'rotating',
             descriptor = EXCLUDED.descriptor,
             address = NULL,
             "updatedAt" = EXCLUDED."updatedAt"
